findings.description: TestDaemonStart_TokenMissing only asserts that the error contains 'api-token'. The spec requires the error to instruct the user to run 'argus token mint --scope hera'. The implementation does include that wording but the test does not pin it, so a regression that dropped the actionable suggestion would not fail this test. Recommend asserting strings.Contains(err.Error(), "argus token mint --scope hera").

TestLoadToken_FileEmpty only asserts that the error contains 'empty'. The spec's empty-token scenario requires the same instructional 'argus token mint --scope hera' wording as the missing-file case (which IS pinned in TestLoadToken_FileMissing). The implementation provides the wording in both cases; this test should match the missing-file test by also asserting strings.Contains(err.Error(), "argus token mint").
